growth_protocol_ch1: This retrospective study was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Asan Medical Center (AMC; 2020-0064). It included 105 consecutive MIBC (cT2-4aN0M0) patients who underwent TUR with available formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tumor tissues and at least 3 cycles of NAC between August 2011 and August 2017 at AMC. Among the 105 patients, 60 patients who underwent curative surgery after NAC were designated as validation cohort since their pathologic response of NAC was assessable using the surgical specimens.
extract_protocol_ch1: Laser capture microdissection (LCMD) was performed on hematoxylin-eosin-stained tissue slides using a Leica LMD6500 laser capture dissection microscope (Leica Microsystems) as described by the manufacturer. The urothelial carcinoma areas were meticulously microdissected as close as possible to the perimeter of tumor cells to avoid contamination of stroma and inflammatory cells while avoiding tumor necrotic area. Total RNA from the LCMD tumor tissues was isolated using the RNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA), including treatment with DNase I (QIAGEN) | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using LEXOGEN Quant-Seq Library Prep Kit (Cat#001.24) standard protocols.

It included 105 consecutive MIBC (cT2-4aN0M0) patients who underwent TUR with available formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tumor tissues and at least 3 cycles of NAC between August 2011 and August 2017 at AMC. Among the 105 patients, 60 patients who underwent curative surgery after NAC were designated as validation cohort since their pathologic response of NAC was assessable using the surgical specimens.
extract_protocol_ch1: Laser capture microdissection (LCMD) was performed on hematoxylin-eosin-stained tissue slides using a Leica LMD6500 laser capture dissection microscope (Leica Microsystems) as described by the manufacturer. The urothelial carcinoma areas were meticulously microdissected as close as possible to the perimeter of tumor cells to avoid contamination of stroma and inflammatory cells while avoiding tumor necrotic area. Total RNA from the LCMD tumor tissues was isolated using the RNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA), including treatment with DNase I (QIAGEN) | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using LEXOGEN Quant-Seq Library Prep Kit (Cat#001.24) standard protocols.
